reviews.summary: GRASS had a scheduled token-unlock event on September 28, 2026—roughly one day before this snapshot—creating immediate supply/recipient-distribution risk during a momentum entry.
materialRisks: A September 28, 2026 GRASS unlock occurred immediately before the signal. Independent trackers differ on the precise amount, but both identify a current vesting release; this can add near-term sell-side and liquidity volatility risk. ([investors.defillama.com](https://investors.defillama.com/unlocks/grass?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: DefiLlama’s unlock tracker records September 28 cliff releases for Foundation & Ecosystem Growth (2.61M GRASS) and Contributors (4.89M GRASS), while noting some allocation schedules are modelled linearly where no specific schedule is available. ([investors.defillama.com](https://investors.defillama.com/unlocks/grass?utm_source=openai))

Tokenomics.com reports a larger September 28 release estimate of 33.43M GRASS (3.3% of total supply), chiefly allocated to private investors and insiders; the amount is not corroborated by the DefiLlama tracker, so use the existence—not the exact size—of the unlock as the firm risk fact. ([app.tokenomics.com](https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/grass/unlocks?utm_source=openai))
No directly relevant fresh official evidence was found of a GRASS protocol exploit, token-contract incident, exchange delisting, or regulatory action in the reviewed period.
